title: Normalized external tensor sections on one affine product open
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and $F,G$ quasi-coherent module sheaves [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $A\subseteq X$ and $V\subseteq Y$ be affine opens. Put $Z=X\times_kY$, $W=\operatorname{pr}_2^{-1}V$, $E=\operatorname{pr}_1^*F\otimes\operatorname{pr}_2^*G$ [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations], and $J=W.\iota^{-1}(\operatorname{pr}_1^{-1}A)$. Write $K=W.\iota(J)$, with its inclusions into $\operatorname{pr}_1^{-1}A$ and $\operatorname{pr}_2^{-1}V$. There exists an additive equivalence $\Gamma(A,F)\otimes_k\Gamma(V,G|_V)\cong\Gamma(J,E|_W)$. The $k$ action on the first factor is restriction from the global structure-ring action along $f$. On a pure tensor $s\otimes t$, the equivalence sends $s$ to its projection-adjunction-unit section restricted to $K$, sends $t$ first through the canonical restriction-section equivalence to $G(V)$ and then through the other projection-unit section restricted to $K$, takes their tensor section, and uses the inverse restriction-section equivalence for $W.\iota$ to obtain a section on $J$. No finite index set, cover or differential is assumed; empty opens are allowed.

proof.text: Identify K with pr1 inverse A intersect pr2 inverse V, using the image-preimage formula for the open immersion W.ι. The product of the two affine opens is affine. Mathlib isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen and isIso_pushoutSection_iff identify the two projection appLE ring maps as a pushout, first over Gamma(Spec k,top), then over k via GammaSpecIso. Scalar-map compatibility follows from naturality of the structure sheaf maps.

Apply exists_tensorPullback_affine_sections to each projection on the affine target open A or V and affine source open K. Swap the source tensor factors and use its linearity clause to obtain C-linear equivalences C tensor_R M to the first projection sections and C tensor_S N to the second, where R=Gamma(X,A), S=Gamma(Y,V), C=Gamma(Z,K). Each takes 1 tensor s to the original projection adjunction unit restricted to K.

Use the pushout algebra cancellation equivalences and tensor commutativity to identify (C tensor_R M) tensor_C (C tensor_S N) with M tensor_k N. The inverse sends s tensor t to (1 tensor s) tensor (1 tensor t). Tensor the two projection-section equivalences and compose with tensorSectionsMap, which is bijective on affine K for the quasi-coherent projection pullbacks. Its pure-tensor formula is tmulSection.

The identity on F(A) identifies restriction of scalars through the global structure ring with the local scalar action. Restriction-section isomorphisms identify the right factor with G(V) k-linearly and the output with sections of E restricted to W on J. Compose them with the preceding equivalence; the tracked pure-tensor formula is exactly externalTensorOpenPureSection. All operations apply to empty opens and zero section modules.

theorem externalTensor_affine_open_sections [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hA : IsAffineOpen A) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (J : ((pullback.snd f g) ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.Opens)
    (hJ : J = ((pullback.snd f g) ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ⁻¹ᵁ ((pullback.fst f g) ⁻¹ᵁ A))
    (hK : ((pullback.snd f g) ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ''ᵁ J ≤ (pullback.fst f g) ⁻¹ᵁ A)
    (hKV : ((pullback.snd f g) ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ''ᵁ J ≤ (pullback.snd f g) ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    ∃ e : ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (scalarMap f ⊤)).obj
        (F.presheafModuleCat.obj (op A)) ⊗[k]
          scalarObj (V.ι ≫ g) (G.restrict V.ι) (op ⊤)) ≃+
        Γ((externalCupCoefficients f g F G).restrict
          ((pullback.snd f g) ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι, J),
      ∀ (s : (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (scalarMap f ⊤)).obj
          (F.presheafModuleCat.obj (op A)))
        (t : scalarObj (V.ι ≫ g) (G.restrict V.ι) (op ⊤)),
        e (s ⊗ₜ[k] t) = externalTensorOpenPureSection f g F G A V J hK hKV s t
